interpretation: A faible Pe, la diffusion longitudinale participe au melange et le gain de l'agitation est amorti ; a Pe eleve, le gain tend vers la borne theorique (1 - 1/kappa).
article_snippet_en: A parametric study over Pe in [2.5, 20] and kappa in [1, 8] shows that the mixing gain ranges from 32% to 84%, approaching the theoretical bound (1 - 1/kappa) as Pe increases, while low-Pe regimes are partially homogenized by longitudinal diffusion.
